description: Save an Entity of a project as an entity template version: its members (the components bound to it, with the positions, rotations and colours they hold). Without templateId it updates the template the Entity was imported from (or makes a new one, under the Entity's id); asNew: true always makes a new template. Updating an existing template needs baseVersion, the version read with r3_entity_read: if the template changed since, nothing is saved and the answer names the current version. The project itself is not changed. The answer lists every reference a member holds to a component outside the Entity (outsideReferences): infrastructure (scene, world, camera, listener, renderer, transport) is expected and re-bound on import; anything else (a geometry or material left outside) is listed first, because an import into another project leaves it empty. The save is not refused for them.

asNew.description: true saves a NEW template, never updating one.

baseVersion.description: The template version you read (r3_entity_read): required to update an existing template.

entityRef.description: The Entity (its entityRef, or its id).

note.description: What changed, kept with the version.

templateId.description: The template to update (default: the one the Entity came from, else a new one).

name: r3_entity_save_template

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Save an Entity as a template
